decisions.reason: The enclosed laser workstation extends the firm's established laser portfolio, and with turnover growing, the firm expanding and slack available, management has no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, so it keeps the product despite its thin website visibility.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer is close to the core business, is presented on its own page, and feeds recurring consumables revenue, so results likely meet aspirations and dropping it would bring no benefit.

The piezo inkjet printer fills a core application gap next to the thermal inkjet line, is prominently presented, and fits the firm's single-source strategy, so a growing firm with slack has every reason to keep it.
